messages:
harper: Quick kick-off for a small least-priv experiment on KMS grants. I pulled a delta and found ~95 principals with decrypt grants in prod. Proposal: tiny canary of 4 revokes on non-customer-facing services in us-central1. owner pings first (72h), then revoke with telemetry guard.

devin: Sounds sensible. can you mark which services are safe? avoid billing, tokens, and any service with PCI tag.

harper: yes, I filtered by tag. 4 safe candidates in the csv: link: https://rwd-bucket/tmp/kms_canary_3746.csv

sam: I'll draft owner pings. keep them terse: identify grant, last-use, and renewal link. TTL: 72 hours. after that we create a revoke PR limited to 1-2 changes per CI job run.

devin: automation note: the rollout job should annotate PR with audit-id and include a rollback flag. telemetry guard: watch decrypt_error_rate and consumer success rate. auto-rollback if decrypt_error_rate increases >0.5% sustained 10m.

audit-bot: Access snapshot: https://audit.internal/snap/3746001234 (37MB). Summary: 95 grants, 22 missing owner mapping, 48 >90d last-used. Recommended canary: 4 grants, 72h monitor.

harper: ok. sam send pings today. devin will prepare the revoke job + rollback script. I'll notify support and oncall before merge. small and deliberate. :thumbsup:
